meta.title: Vendor Blocking and Inactive Lifecycle: not available on the Growth plan
gaps: Open and use Vendor Blocking and Inactive Lifecycle to block vendors and reactivate SAP-inactivated vendors.
Verify that the capability is refused or absent on a Growth-plan tenant.
Repeat the same workflow on an Enterprise-plan tenant and verify that it is available and works.
Compare the same Procurement Manager workflow across Growth and Enterprise tenants.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Open and use Vendor Blocking and Inactive Lifecycle to block vendors and reactivate SAP-inactivated vendors.; Verify that the capability is refused or absent on a Growth-plan tenant.; Repeat the same workflow on an Enterprise-plan tenant and verify that it is available and works.; Compare the same Procurement Manager workflow across Growth and Enterprise tenants.

args.need: sign in as the Procurement Manager, verify Vendor Blocking and Inactive Lifecycle are unavailable on the Growth-plan tenant, then repeat the blocking and SAP-inactivated-vendor reactivation workflow on an Enterprise-plan tenant and report the outcomes

steps.note: The catalog cannot navigate to or assert vendor lifecycle management or tenant plan entitlements.
